title: Typeface Overview
slide_intent: Assign different voices to headline, support and detail so readers can distinguish the main invitation from information that follows.
strategic_value: A shared Flame family can preserve Burger King’s personality across a loud headline and routine explanatory copy.
demonstration: Three stacked roles pair Flame Bold with Eat Loud, Flame Regular with a delivery line, and Flame Sans with a body paragraph.
practical_value: Choose Bold for headlines, Regular for subheads and Sans for body copy using these role specimens.

content_islands.name: Family explanation
content_islands.spec: Place the explanatory column at left, including the restriction on modifying the font.

content_islands.name: Role specimens
content_islands.spec: Stack the three labeled type roles in the middle with their specimens to the right.

content_islands.name: Example qualification
content_islands.spec: Retain the small legal-review note beneath the specimens.

ingredient.name: Flame family roles
ingredient.role: Separate emphasis from supporting information while retaining a common voice.
ingredient.application: Use Flame Bold for headlines, Flame Regular for subheads and Flame Sans for body copy. Do not modify the font without BKC legal approval.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2020 partner guidelines, PDF produced January 2021. Printed examples require BK legal trademark clearance and local legal review before use.

reference_purposes.Intent: The copy explains that three styles allow a flexible voice while keeping one consistent brand impression.
reference_purposes.Expression: The three actual phrases demonstrate Bold, Regular and Sans.
reference_purposes.Application: Headline, subhead and body labels assign each style a role.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Modification or adaptation of Flame requires BKC legal approval; examples carry a legal-review qualification.
